messages:
alice_support: FYI customer (ACME) reporting intermittent 400s on GitHub SSO callback. Browser shows "invalid_request: state_mismatch" but our server logs show a code present on the initial request. Happening ~20% of attempts.

olivia_customer: Repro steps from their side: 
1) Click "Sign in with GitHub" on https://app.acme.example/
2) GitHub auth -> redirects back to https://app.acme.example/auth/callback?code=XXX&state=abc123 (302)
3) Final GET to /auth/callback sometimes arrives without querystring and returns 400 body: "missing_code_verifier". Happens intermittently across browsers.

olivia_customer: They captured headers for both requests:
```
GET /auth/callback?code=XYZ&state=abc123 302
Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
Via: 1.1 cdn.example
X-Cache: HIT
```
And the subsequent request that errors:
```
GET /auth/callback 200
Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
Via: 1.1 cdn.example
X-Cache: HIT
```

mark_eng: Hmm. That looks like a cached redirect/response issue. If the CDN or edge worker is using the path-only as cache key and caching the 302 or an intermediate response, the querystring (code+state) can get dropped/replayed. That would explain missing verifier/code on later requests.

mark_eng: Quick checks: can you paste the app logs around the failing timestamps showing whether the incoming request included the querystring? Also which CDN/edge product (CloudFront/Cloudflare/Cloudflare Workers/fastly)?

olivia_customer: They confirmed CF Worker in front of a load balancer. App logs: first hit at 2024-03-12T18:20:01 includes querystring and returns 302->callback, then at 18:20:03 we see a GET to /auth/callback with no querystring from the same edge IP. Body: no code_verifier. So worker is replaying cached response without query.

alice_support: We've seen cache-key misconfig where CF Workers normalized/stripped query params for performance. Short-term workaround for them: add a random nonce param to the callback URL when initiating the flow so the path differs each attempt (ugly but works). Better fix: set the callback path to be not cacheable.

mark_eng: I recommend pushing two changes to the edge config: (1) ensure `/auth/callback` responses include `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate`, and (2) make the worker's cache key include the full querystring for auth endpoints OR bypass cache entirely for those routes. Also ensure 302 responses have the same `no-store` header.

alice_support: Filing internal infra ticket INF-3219 and asking infra to prioritize. Will share KB snippet for customers describing the header fix and workaround.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: workers/auth-cache-fix-4951234567 -> staging (build 7821)

mark_eng: After staging deploy, we'll add telemetry: detect `X-Cache: HIT` + incoming request missing querystring after a recent 302 for same client IP — flag as cached redirect. That will let us find other affected tenants.

olivia_customer: Customer will test with staging after deploy and report back. They also confirmed they can temporarily disable their edge cache as a test.

alice_support: Thanks everyone. I'll keep the customer updated and paste the KB steps when ready. Closing the support escalation after customer validates. :thumbsup:
